```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

people <- read_csv(
  here("people", "people.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

level_order <- c(
  "Bobcat",
  "White-tailed Deer",
  "Raccoon",
  "Squirrel"
)

wildlife_icon <- function(level) {
  case_when(
    level == "Bobcat" ~ "img/wildlife-levels/bobcat.svg",
    level == "White-tailed Deer" ~ "img/wildlife-levels/deer.svg",
    level == "Raccoon" ~ "img/wildlife-levels/raccoon.svg",
    level == "Squirrel" ~ "img/wildlife-levels/squirrel.svg",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

people <- people |>
  mutate(
    wildlife_level = factor(
      wildlife_level,
      levels = level_order
    )
  )

initials <- function(x) {
  parts <- str_split(
    str_squish(x),
    "\\s+"
  )[[1]]

  paste0(
    substr(parts[1], 1, 1),
    ifelse(
      length(parts) > 1,
      substr(parts[length(parts)], 1, 1),
      ""
    )
  )
}

render_badges <- function(x) {

  if (is.na(x) || x == "") {
    return("")
  }

  badges <- str_trim(
    str_split(x, ";")[[1]]
  )

  paste0(
    '<div class="people-badges">',
    paste0(
      '<span class="people-badge">',
      badges,
      '</span>',
      collapse = ""
    ),
    '</div>'
  )
}

render_avatar <- function(name, photo) {

  if (
    !is.na(photo) &&
    photo != ""
  ) {
    paste0(
      '<img class="people-avatar" src="',
      photo,
      '" alt="',
      name,
      '">'
    )
  } else {
    paste0(
      '<div class="people-avatar people-avatar-placeholder">',
      initials(name),
      '</div>'
    )
  }
}

render_email <- function(email) {

  if (
    is.na(email) ||
    email == ""
  ) {
    return("")
  }

  paste0(
    '<a class="people-email" href="mailto:',
    email,
    '">',
    email,
    '</a>'
  )
}

render_leader_card <- function(row) {

  paste0(
    '<article class="leader-card">',

      '<div class="leader-top">',
        render_avatar(
          row$name,
          row$photo
        ),

        '<div class="leader-heading">',
          '<h3>',
            row$name,
          '</h3>',

          '<div class="leader-title">',
            '<strong>',
              row$category,
            '</strong>',
            ' <span>·</span> ',
            '<strong>',
              row$title,
            '</strong>',
          '</div>',

          render_email(
            row$email
          ),
        '</div>',
      '</div>',

      '<p class="leader-bio">',
        row$bio,
      '</p>',

      render_badges(
        row$badges
      ),

    '</article>'
  )
}

render_student_card <- function(row) {

  nprojects <- if (
    is.na(row$projects) ||
    row$projects == ""
  ) {
    0
  } else {
    str_count(
      row$projects,
      ";"
    ) + 1
  }

  # Wildlife level icon
  level_icon <- wildlife_icon(
    as.character(
      row$wildlife_level
    )
  )

  level_badge <- if (
    !is.na(level_icon)
  ) {
    paste0(
      '<div class="wildlife-icon-wrap" title="',
      as.character(
        row$wildlife_level
      ),
      '">',
        '<img class="wildlife-icon" src="',
        level_icon,
        '" alt="',
        as.character(
          row$wildlife_level
        ),
        '">',
      '</div>'
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }

  paste0(
    '<article class="student-card">',

      level_badge,

      '<div class="student-card-top">',

        render_avatar(
          row$name,
          row$photo
        ),

        '<div class="student-heading">',

          '<h3>',
            row$name,
          '</h3>',

          '<div class="student-meta">',
            row$category,
          '</div>',

        '</div>',

      '</div>',

      render_badges(
        row$badges
      ),

      '<div class="student-stats">',

        '<div>',
          '<span class="stat-number">',
            format(
              row$photos_id,
              big.mark = ",",
              scientific = FALSE
            ),
          '</span>',

          '<span class="stat-caption">',
            'photos classified',
          '</span>',
        '</div>',

        '<div>',
          '<span class="stat-number">',
            nprojects,
          '</span>',

          '<span class="stat-caption">',
            ifelse(
              nprojects == 1,
              'project',
              'projects'
            ),
          '</span>',
        '</div>',

      '</div>',

      '<div class="student-details">',

        '<div>',
          '<strong>With the project:</strong> ',
          row$time,
        '</div>',

        '<div>',
          '<strong>Projects:</strong> ',
          str_replace_all(
            row$projects,
            ";",
            " · "
          ),
        '</div>',

      '</div>',

    '</article>'
  )
}

render_past_row <- function(row) {

  paste0(
    '<div class="past-person">',

      '<div class="past-person-main">',
        render_avatar(
          row$name,
          row$photo
        ),

        '<div>',
          '<h4>',
            row$name,
          '</h4>',

          '<div class="past-meta">',
            row$category,
            ' · ',
            as.character(
              row$wildlife_level
            ),
          '</div>',

          render_badges(
            row$badges
          ),
        '</div>',
      '</div>',

      '<div class="past-projects">',
        str_replace_all(
          row$projects,
          ";",
          " · "
        ),
      '</div>',

      '<div class="past-photos">',
        format(
          row$photos_id,
          big.mark = ",",
          scientific = FALSE
        ),
        '<span>',
          ' photos',
        '</span>',
      '</div>',

    '</div>'
  )
}
```

<div class="people-intro">
The SFA Camera Trap Project is built by students and collaborators who contribute at different stages of the research process — from camera deployment and image classification to data analysis, scientific posters, and independent research.
</div>

## Project leadership

```{r}
#| results: asis

leaders <- people |>
  filter(group == "Leadership")

cat('<div class="leadership-grid">')

for (i in seq_len(nrow(leaders))) {
  cat(
    render_leader_card(
      leaders[i, ]
    )
  )
}

cat('</div>')
```

## Project Wildlife Levels

These levels recognize growing experience with the camera-trap workflow. They are a way to visualize students progression through the project.

```{=html}
<div class="level-guide">

  <div class="level-card">
    <img
      class="level-icon"
      src="img/wildlife-levels/squirrel.svg"
      alt="Squirrel">
    <strong>Squirrel</strong>
    <span>Getting started and learning the project workflow.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="level-card">
    <img
      class="level-icon"
      src="img/wildlife-levels/raccoon.svg"
      alt="Raccoon">
    <strong>Raccoon</strong>
    <span>Regular contributor expanding skills and independence.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="level-card">
  <img
      class="level-icon"
      src="img/wildlife-levels/deer.svg"
      alt="White-tailed Deer">
    <strong>White-tailed Deer</strong>
    
    <span>Experienced contributor taking on research or training responsibilities.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="level-card">
    <img
      class="level-icon"
      src="img/wildlife-levels/bobcat.svg"
      alt="Bobcat">
    <strong>Bobcat</strong>
    <span>Core team member with broad experience across multiple project components.</span>
  </div>

</div>
```

## Current student researchers

Students in this group have moved beyond image classification into research questions, data analysis, honors work, posters, or conference presentations.

```{r}
#| results: asis

current_research <- people |>
  filter(
    group == "Student",
    category == "Research",
    status == "Current"
  )

cat('<div class="student-grid">')

for (i in seq_len(nrow(current_research))) {
  cat(
    render_student_card(
      current_research[i, ]
    )
  )
}

cat('</div>')
```

## Current image classification team

These students contribute to one of the most important stages of the project: reviewing camera-trap images, identifying wildlife, and building the databases used in later analyses.

```{r}
#| results: asis

current_classification <- people |>
  filter(
    group == "Student",
    category == "Image classification",
    status == "Current"
  )

cat('<div class="student-grid">')

for (i in seq_len(nrow(current_classification))) {
  cat(
    render_student_card(
      current_classification[i, ]
    )
  )
}

cat('</div>')
```


## Past contributors

Past contributors helped build the datasets, field collections, and research products that support the project today.

```{r}
#| results: asis

past_people <- people |>
  filter(
    group == "Student",
    status %in% c(
      "Past contributor",
      "Alumni"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(
      wildlife_level
    ),
    name
  )

cat('<div class="past-list">')

for (i in seq_len(nrow(past_people))) {
  cat(
    render_past_row(
      past_people[i, ]
    )
  )
}

cat('</div>')
```

## Field crew

Many additional students contribute to camera deployment and retrieval through Wildlife Techniques, Field Station, and other project activities.
